title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that guarantees trustworthiness in embodied navigation through rigorous verification and alignment checks.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential—it provides measurable standards that ensure transparency and enable fair comparison across different navigation systems.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates real-world failure modes and uses protocol-based checks to prevent unsafe behaviors, unlike generic benchmarking that lacks actionable insights.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking drives innovation by revealing gaps in performance—without it, protocols like NavTrust remain theoretical and untested in diverse environments.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Without benchmarking, NavTrust is just an idea—no system can claim trustworthiness without proof against real-world metrics.
